content: अधिकारिन्, अधिकारवत् {%a.%} [अस्त्यर्थे इनि मतुप् वा] .²1 Possessed of authority, having power; निःस्पृहो नाधिकारी स्यात् <ls>Pt. 1. 164</ls>; सन्धिविग्रहकार्य˚, कार्य˚ <ls>H. 3</ls>. .²2 Entitled to, having a right to; सर्वे स्युरधिकारिणः; so उत्तराधिकारिन् heir; धनग्रहण˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; तपस्यनधिकारित्वात् <ls>R. 15. 51</ls> not qualified or authorised. .²3 Belonging to, owned by. .²4 Fit for. --{%m.%} ({@-री, -वान्@}) .²1 An official, officer; न निष्प्रयोजनम् अधिकारवन्तः प्रभुभिराहूयन्ते <ls>Mu. 3</ls>; a functionary, superintendent, head, director, governor. .²2 A rightful claimant, proprietor, master, owner. .²3 One qualified to sacrifice or perform sacred works. .²4 Man as the lord of creation. .²5 One well versed in the Vedānta.
